metadata.title: Twilio Stock Sinks as Slowing Growth Throws ‘Cold Water’ on Benefits From AI<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Twilio Stock Sinks as Slowing Growth Throws ‘Cold Water’ on Benefits From AI
Twilio shares fell sharply Friday after the communications software company reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings, but slowing revenue growth raised concerns that its artificial-intelligence business isn’t living up to expectations.
